about: Golden vectors for document v4 (docs/contracts/document-schema-v4.md, SRV-10A). All data is invented.

Derived outside the repository code: Python json.dumps with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=False (JCS for this data: integer numbers, ASCII keys) and hashlib.sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes. Never regenerate them from the code under test.
Each rejected document lists every expected error as [path, code].
